title: HTTP Client Private Environment Variables
description: Private environment variables, OAuth secrets, and cached tokens for Kulala HTTP client files (http-client.private.env.json).

kulalaDefaultHeaders.description: Default HTTP headers applied to every request in this scope.

kulalaDefaultCurlOptions.description: Default curl flags applied to every request in this scope (Kulala extension).

items.description: A curl command-line flag, e.g. "--insecure" or "--max-time 5".

oauth2PrivateOverride.description: Private OAuth 2.0 fields merged into the public auth config with the same auth ID. Type and Grant Type may be omitted when overriding secrets only.

Type.description: Optional when merging into an existing public OAuth2 config.

Grant Type.description: OAuth 2.0 grant type. Usually defined in http-client.env.json.

Client Secret.description: Confidential client secret. Required for Client Credentials grant.

Password.description: Resource owner password for the Password grant.

Assertion.description: Kulala extension: pre-built JWT assertion for Client Credentials "jwt".

private_key.description: Kulala extension: PEM private key for RS256 JWT assertions.

Client ID.description: Override the public Client ID when the private file contains a full OAuth2 entry.

Token URL.description: Override the public Token URL when the private file contains a full OAuth2 entry.

Auth URL.description: Override the public Auth URL when the private file contains a full OAuth2 entry.

Redirect URL.description: Override the public Redirect URL when the private file contains a full OAuth2 entry.

mockPrivateOverride.description: Private Mock auth fields merged into the public auth config with the same auth ID. Type may be omitted when overriding tokens only.

Type.description: Optional when merging into an existing public Mock config.

securityAuthPrivate.description: Private auth overrides keyed by the same auth ID used in http-client.env.json.

^[\\w.-]+$.description: Private fields for auth ID referenced as {{$auth.token("auth-id")}} in .http files.

securityConfigPrivate.description: Private security settings merged into public authentication configurations.

clientCertificate.description: Path to the client certificate file for mutual TLS.

clientCertificateKey.description: Path to the client certificate private key, when stored separately.

hasCertificatePassphrase.description: When true, prompt for the client certificate passphrase at request time.

verifyHostCertificate.description: When false, skip TLS certificate verification for this environment.

oauth2TokenData.description: Cached OAuth 2.0 token response. Written automatically by Kulala after successful authentication.

access_token.description: Bearer access token used to authorize API requests.

token_type.description: Token type returned by the authorization server, usually "Bearer".

expires_in.description: Token lifetime in seconds as reported by the authorization server.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token used to obtain a new access token without repeating user authorization.

id_token.description: OpenID Connect ID token, when returned by the provider.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the access token expires. Calculated from expires_in when absent.

authData.description: Cached OAuth tokens keyed by auth ID. Managed automatically; edit only when debugging.

^[\\w.-]+$.description: Token cache for auth ID referenced as {{$auth.token("auth-id")}}.

customEnvVariable.description: Custom private environment variable. Supports {{variable}} substitution in .http files when loaded from the private env file.

privateEnvironmentSection.description: Private variables, OAuth secrets, and token cache for a single named environment.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor validation and autocompletion.

$kulalaShared.description: Kulala-only: private variables and defaults shared across all environments in this file.
